en.headline: Woman arrested over beauty parlour product containing undeclared controlled drugs
en.dek: The Department of Health and police acted against a Causeway Bay parlour after laboratory tests found a topical cream labelled Dermasa contained three local anaesthetics classified as Part 1 poisons.
body: A 40-year-old woman was arrested on Friday on suspicion of the illegal sale and possession of Part 1 poisons and an unregistered pharmaceutical product, the Department of Health said.

Officers from the department, acting with police, conducted an enforcement operation at a beauty parlour on Hysan Avenue in Causeway Bay. The action followed a complaint. Investigators earlier purchased a sample of a product labelled “Dermasa” from the premises for analysis by the Government Laboratory.

Test results showed the sample contained prilocaine as well as lignocaine and tetracaine, both Part 1 poisons under the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance. The product is also suspected to be an unregistered pharmaceutical product. Local anaesthetics of this combination are prescription medicines that should be supplied only under a doctor’s direction by an authorised seller of poisons under pharmacist supervision.

The department urged anyone who has bought the product to stop using it immediately and to consult a healthcare professional if they feel unwell. Unregistered pharmaceutical products carry no guarantee of safety, quality or efficacy. Illegal sale or possession of Part 1 poisons or unregistered pharmaceutical products carries a maximum penalty of a HK$100,000 fine and two years’ imprisonment for each offence.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣美容院售含未標示受管制藥物產品 女子被捕
zh.dek: 衞生署聯同警方採取行動，化驗顯示名為Dermasa的外用產品含有三種屬第1部毒藥的局部麻醉劑。
body: 衞生署星期五表示，一名40歲女子涉嫌非法售賣及管有第1部毒藥及未經註冊藥劑製品被捕。
署方聯同警方在銅鑼灣希慎道一間美容院採取執法行動。行動源於一宗投訴。調查人員較早前在該處購買名為「Dermasa」的產品樣本，交由政府化驗所分析。
化驗結果顯示樣本含有丙胺卡因，以及屬於《藥劑業及毒藥條例》下第1部毒藥的利多卡因和丁卡因。有關產品亦懷疑屬未經註冊藥劑製品。含有這三種局部麻醉劑組合的外用產品屬處方藥物，只應在醫生指示下，由獲授權毒藥銷售商在註冊藥劑師監督下供應。
衞生署呼籲已購買該產品的市民立即停用，如有不適應徵詢醫護人員意見。未經註冊藥劑製品的安全、質素及效能並無保證。非法售賣或管有第1部毒藥或未經註冊藥劑製品，每項罪名最高可被罰款10萬元及監禁兩年。
